locationVault.title: Golden Hour Location Vault
locationVault.description: Save one optional location to power sunset glow predictions and positioning recommendations.
locationVault.encryptionNote: Stored encrypted at rest and used server-side to generate derived weather/light insights. Raw coordinates are not exposed in the well-being UI.
locationVault.gpsHint: Prefer not to share device GPS? Pick a city preset below.
locationVault.searchHint: Manual search is optional. Most people can use current location or a quick pick.
locationVault.successSaved: Location saved securely for glow insights.

errors.genericGeo: Could not read your current location.

birthdayVault.title: Cosmic Birthday Vault
birthdayVault.description: Your birth data powers personalized astrological insights. Encrypted so only you can access it.
birthdayVault.securityBody: Your birthday is encrypted on your device before being stored. Even we cannot see it. Only you, with your passphrase, can decrypt and view your birth data.
birthdayVault.emptyBody: Add your birthday for personalized astrological readings, timing advice, and cosmic insights.
birthdayVault.dialogSetupDescription: Your data will be encrypted with your passphrase before storage.
birthdayVault.includeTime: Include birth time for day/night precision
birthdayVault.birthTimeHintOn: Birth time enables day/night readings and more precise cosmic guidance.
birthdayVault.birthTimeHintOff: Birth time is optional but provides more accurate readings.
birthdayVault.passphraseWarnBody: We cannot recover your passphrase. If you forget it, you will need to delete and re-enter your birthday data.
birthdayVault.lockedHint: Enter your passphrase to unlock cosmic insights
birthdayVault.dialogUnlockDescription: Enter your passphrase to decrypt and view your birthday data.
birthdayVault.dialogDeleteDescription: This will permanently delete your encrypted birthday data. You can set it up again afterward.
birthdayVault.dialogDeleteDescriptionShort: This will permanently delete your encrypted birthday data.
birthdayVault.monthlyPowerHint: These dates each month align with your cosmic energy

err.cryptoUnsupported: Your browser does not support the required encryption features.
err.passphraseShort: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters
err.saveFailed: Failed to save birthday. Please try again.
err.unlockFailed: Failed to unlock. Check your passphrase.

birthdayVault.successStored: Your cosmic birthday has been securely stored!
birthdayVault.successDeleted: Birthday data has been permanently deleted.

housekeeping.title: Arrangements (smart lists)
housekeeping.description: Smart classify fans by spend, DM/thread activity, cold engagement, and freeloader buckets — then sync to OnlyFans lists and Fansly tags. Configure under Fans → Arrangements.

social.title: Social
social.description: Accounts used for reputation monitoring. Only you can connect or disconnect them.

billing.protectionDescLive: Standalone monthly anti-piracy for extra fan and clip storefronts—leak checks, takedown help, and a dedicated Protection hub. Separate bill from single-platform and Bundled plans: ManyVids on the Bundled plan above is part of that subscription; Protection is its own subscription for broader storefront coverage.
billing.protectionEnrollmentClosed: New subscriptions are not open yet. We will enable checkout on this card when Multiplatform Protection enrollment launches.

billing.trialFinePrint: Billing begins when the trial window ends unless you cancel beforehand. You authorize future charges by completing Stripe Checkout.
billing.invoicesDescription: Hosted by Stripe—the same ledger and receipts as Checkout and your billing portal.
billing.invoicesSubscribeHint: Subscribe and your invoice PDFs will show up here—delivered through Stripe automatically.
